block.whistle_stt.model.title: Whistle STT
block.whistle_stt.model.description: Transcribe completed audio clips locally with the pinned Whistle CPU model; no cloud speech API.
block.whistle_stt.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.whistle_stt.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.whistle_stt.help_allowed_root: All audio paths must stay inside this directory. Empty uses the application root.
block.whistle_stt.help_language: Auto-detect or choose one of Whistle’s seven languages. French is supported.
block.whistle_stt.help_keywords: JSON array of names or short phrases, for example ["BloxSmith", "HackInvent"]. These are hints, not instructions.
block.whistle_stt.help_word_timestamps: Add word start/end times and model probabilities to the JSON output.
block.whistle_stt.help_download_missing: On first transcription only: fetch pinned official weights/engine, verify SHA-256, then reuse the block cache. Disable for offline-only use.
block.whistle_stt.help_max_duration_sec: Whistle accepts at most 30 seconds per clip. Longer files are refused, never silently cut.
block.whistle_stt.help_max_file_bytes: Bound the input before decoding. Default 32 MiB.
block.whistle_stt.help_timeout_sec: Bound local conversion and inference; Stop cancels owned processes.
block.whistle_stt.help_download_timeout_: Additional allowance for the initial asset download. No audio is uploaded.
